comment: The rules of the headless runner of PR-15 (D-1181, D-1184, D-1185). The runs start on the maps of the list in turn by seed: an even seed in the fixture dungeon, where Game starts, and an odd seed on the fixture hub. A run ends as complete when the goal flag is on: the party beat the rats in the straw of the fixture hub. PR-35 links the dungeon and the hub through the fixture overworld, so a dungeon run can reach the goal, and PR-17 moves the goal to the story of the first playable. Each policy has its own budget (D-1259). PR-35 measured the greedy budget: three times 4,555, the longest greedy run to the goal over seeds 1 to 2000. The random budget stays the 2,349 of PR-15, because a random run seldom reaches the goal.
